_comment: The exact X-Playwright-Record-Diagnostics envelope a record/edit save answers with when a posted column is not in TCA, alongside status 422 and no Location. The extension asserts its real header matches this; the toolkit asserts its client turns it into the thrown message. Neither side may change it alone. Entries are dropped to keep the header inside a webserver's buffer, so count can exceed the number listed.

errors.message: Unknown column "bodytxt" on tt_content. TCA has no such column, so DataHandler would drop it and save the record without it. Did you mean "bodytext"?
